tools.name: get_server_guide
tools.description: Start here when connecting an agent: explains what workspaceAlberta does, the search-to-bid-review workflow, handoff fields, data boundaries and unsupported actions. No model or network call.

tools.name: get_contract_details

tools.name: list_upcoming_deadlines

tools.name: summarize_contracts

tools.name: refresh_data
tools.description: Refresh contract data from CanadaBuys.

tools.name: set_business_profile

tools.name: find_opportunities

tools.name: get_my_profile

Pass description or profile to rank by a TypeSafe Jev supply-fit classification (yes, partial, or no) after a commodity-code prefilter. Keyword

tools.name: get_opportunity_details
tools.description: Get details for any federal CanadaBuys or Alberta APC opportunity by reference number, including UNSPSC, GSIN, trade agreements, and Buy Canadian flags when the source published them.

tools.name: list_deadlines
tools.description: List CanadaBuys and Alberta APC opportunities closing soon.

tools.name: find_matching_opportunities
tools.description: Rank CanadaBuys and Alberta APC opportunities for any business profile, in any sector. Pass an inline `profile` to describe the business per call. A description is classified with TypeSafe Jev (yes, partial, or no, and goods supply, services, training, or subcontract) after a commodity-code prefilte

tools.name: daily_bid_brief
tools.description: Generate a free daily bid brief from the full CanadaBuys and Alberta APC catalogues for any business. Pass an inline `profile` to describe the business per call. Best fits start with the same TypeSafe Jev supply classification as find_business_fit. Domestic-preference flags are included when a match

tools.name: find_business_fit
tools.description: Rank open CanadaBuys and Alberta Purchasing Connection notices for a free-text business description. A commodity-code and term prefilter cuts the catalogues to a short candidate list, then TypeSafe Jev classifies each notice: could this business supply it (yes, partial, or no) and as which capabilit

tools.name: search_alberta_opportunities
tools.description: Search Alberta Purchasing Connection opportunities from Alberta public-sector buyers. When configured, search terms or business capabilities may be sent to Cohere to select commodity filters. See /privacy.

tools.name: get_alberta_opportunity_details
tools.description: Get full Alberta Purchasing Connection details by reference number, such as AB-2026-03908.

tools.name: list_alberta_deadlines
tools.description: List open Alberta Purchasing Connection opportunities closing soon.

tools.name: summarize_alberta_opportunities
tools.description: Summarize current open Alberta Purchasing Connection opportunities by category.

tools.name: find_alberta_opportunities
tools.description: Find Alberta Purchasing Connection opportunities that match your business profile. Pass an inline `profile` to describe the business per call. When configured, search terms or business capabilities may be sent to Cohere to select commodity filters. See /privacy.

tools.name: process_bid_room
tools.description: Process tender attachments in E2B: sends documents and business context to E2B, PDF page images/images and extracted evidence to Cohere Parse and Command A+. See /privacy for processing locations. For Alberta APC postings, the first call returns a private upload link: the user downloads the document

tools.name: classify_tender
tools.description: List what a bidder must supply for one tender: splits the tender PDFs into clauses, classifies each clause and page with TypeSafe AI's Jev classifier, and groups the results into one requirement per kind (for example key personnel, mandatory site visit, bid bond), with a mandatory flag, the Workspac

tools.name: check_cohere_status
tools.description: Check whether the optional Cohere Command A+ model integration is configured. Does not call the model.

tools.name: analyze_contract_with_cohere
tools.description: Use Cohere Command A+ to review a CanadaBuys tender and explain fit, risks, and next steps. Hosted: sign-in and an active workspaceAlberta Pro subscription required.

tools.name: match_industrial_support_programs
tools.description: Read-only catalog of industrial and tariff support for any Canadian business, including the October 2026 $8.72 billion federal-provincial package and national programs an Alberta firm can ask about: PrairiesCan Regional Tariff Response Initiative, the Strategic Response Fund, the Canada Strong Diver

tools.name: watch_opportunity
tools.description: Add a CanadaBuys or Alberta APC opportunity to your persistent watchlist, with an optional note. Hosted: sign-in and an active workspaceAlberta Pro subscription required.

tools.name: list_watchlist
tools.description: List watched opportunities sorted by closing date, with days remaining and notes. Hosted: sign-in and an active workspaceAlberta Pro subscription required.

tools.name: unwatch_opportunity
tools.description: Remove an opportunity from the watchlist by reference number. Hosted: sign-in and an active workspaceAlberta Pro subscription required.

tools.name: bid_no_bid_scorecard
tools.description: Fast deterministic bid/no-bid checklist for one opportunity in any sector: profile fit, runway to closing, region match, Buy Canadian or other domestic-preference flags, and a go/caution/no-go verdict with reasons. No model call. Hosted: sign-in and an active workspaceAlberta Pro subscription requir

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_server_guide · Private data: process_bid_room, classify_tender · Public sink: find_business_fit, process_bid_room, classify_tender · Destructive: classify_tender, unwatch_opportunity.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_server_guide · Private data: process_bid_room, classify_tender · Public sink: find_business_fit, process_bid_room, classify_tender · Destructive: classify_tender, unwatch_opportunity

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
